title: AI Chat Assistant
objective: Build a conversational UI and secure backend adapter for a hosted model API.
scenario: Build a conversational UI and secure backend adapter for a hosted model API. Build incrementally, start with mock services, and record how critical behavior can be reproduced.
target_skills: Conversation history with a documented reset behavior
Streaming where the chosen provider supports it
Loading, empty, cancellation, and provider-error states
Server-side API credentials and bounded request controls
Clear AI-use disclosure and feedback/correction controls
